prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent decorative annotation for an architectural studio portfolio website
Primary request: Create one standalone hand-drawn doodle of a simple tubular cantilever chair, inspired by the chair silhouette in the reference image.
Input images: Image 1 is a style and silhouette reference only.
Style/medium: bold cobalt-blue paint marker or wax crayon, visibly hand-drawn with slightly uneven edges and overlapping strokes; energetic, graphic, naive but intentional.
Composition/framing: centered single chair, three-quarter side view, generous transparent margin around the mark.
Color palette: one saturated cobalt blue only.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background; preserve a clean recognizable chair silhouette; no typography, no names, no photograph, no room, no shadows, no border, no watermark, no extra objects. Do not reproduce any text from the reference.
